definition.label: Little reef aquarium
definition.description: Wide oak aquarium with reviewed side/rear panels, a planted teal tank and two animated fish.

render.origin: centered floor pivot; canonical front reference anchor (48,60)

referenceStudy.approach: Centered volumetric hood/cabinet with approved side/rear material maps, inward-facing water backgrounds, layered planting and two animated crossed fish profiles. Native actor projection is retained.

turnaround.calibration: Original front stays canonical. Generated references share one uniform scale; foot baselines reflect facing-specific floor depth. Explicit projection calibration is separate from physical geometry.

projection.note: Profile and three-quarter pitch calibrated to the accepted sheet; actor artwork retains its native camera.

definition.label: Trail couch
definition.description: Rounded sage sofa with two scalloped back cushions, paired floral pillows, rolled arms and timber feet.

referenceStudy.approach: Shared rounded cushions, tapered padded arms and lower rear panel with face-aligned source paint. Calibrated profile cameras and projected contacts retain the actor's native projection.

turnaround.calibration: References use one uniform import scale. Couch front/rear retain the original source camera; profiles use an explicit 12-degree camera calibration. Actor artwork keeps the shared native camera and docks through projected pelvis/seat contacts. Generated camera geometry remains approximate.

projection.note: Couch side projection follows the flatter generated profiles. Front/rear retain the source camera; actors retain their shared camera with pelvis docking.
